text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival has arrived.
Everywhere is bustling with excitement, packed to the brim.
And standing right by the gate is—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There has been an increase in lost children~
Please keep a close eye on your little ones~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If you ever get lost, please call out to any of the Umamusume big sisters! Look out for this mark!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: These ears, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Just look for this tail right here~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything else giving you trouble,
please don't hesitate to call on me~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, uuugh~ I really...
just can't get used to this pose~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. Having to promote myself all over again
feels rather peculiar.
choice_data_list: You're doing a great job as a guide.
You're doing a great job as a guide, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wha!? I'm just an Umamusume big sis!
I'm not scary at all, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... Let's calm down, Spe-chan.
This person isn't lost~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, what!?
Grass-chan's Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... So there are no lost children after all.
That's a relie—

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaahhhh!!
Big broootheeer!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, that person over there
really does seem to be lost~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-A-A lost child!?
Then it's finally our time to—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she's not here!?
...Grass-cha~~n!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I see, I see~ So that's how you got separated from your big brother...

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Big bro ran away,
and now he's gone...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...!
Mother, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness...! 
Here you are...!"

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, everyone.
...Come on, Big Brother. Say thank you too.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Personally, I would've been fine
leaving this one lost."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Still, his little sister was crying
‘Big brother, big brother’ over and over, wasn't she?”

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: "Who cares! They're just annoying! Like I'd ever want a little sister!"

text_block_list.name: Mother
text_block_list.text: Hey!! You're doing it again——!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Well then, allow me to volunteer
as your 'big sister'~.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm more than happy to have another cute little sister.
Ufufu~♪

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Fweh...? B-Big bro...?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on! Don't take her away!
She's my little sister—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... See, you really are
my "Onii-chan" after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
" 'Spilt water cannot be gathered again'... Truly,
words once spoken can never be taken back."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If it is feelings you wish to hold dear,
you must not go letting go with your own hands.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"...Look, we already made up!
Are you happy now?!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes.
Please have a wonderful time~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ As your elder, I merely
passed along what needed to be said~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...However, it truly is painful
to harden one's heart against children."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I shall humbly accept
those kind words of yours~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite harboring so many mixed feelings,
seeing her firmly carry out her role made for a day
that truly felt true to who she is.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes.
Please have a wonderful time~.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! ...Well, where do you wanna go next?

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, anywhere's great as long as I'm with you, Onii-chan!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: ...Good grief.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm truly envious.
To be adored so deeply by your little sister—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Shall I give her a call tonight?
It's been a while.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my~. Even I am
properly an "older sister," you know.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Have I not mentioned this story to you yet,
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪ Actually, my little sister is so brilliant that she was invited to an American boarding school—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with her "big sister mode" engaged,
I ended up listening to stories about her little sister in America
for nearly an hour.
